name: app_activity
description: What was built and changed on the phone: for each app made with create_app, its versions with a plain line for what changed in each (added, removed or changed screens, actions and data), its http data sources and how often each refreshes, and its events (create, update, action, data refresh). Pass id for one app. Fails with not_installed.

id.description: App id; omit for every app

name: apply_update
description: Apply the ready release: the app restarts on the new bundle, like restart. After 3 boots that throw, the phone goes back to the old release and the state is reverted with reason crash_loop. Fails with not_ready unless the state is ready. Simulated; logged in device_log.

name: approval_approve
description: Approve a held promote so it goes live. The proposer cannot approve it, and an agent cannot approve an agent's proposal: that is refused with rule self_approval. Ask the owner to approve in that case. Both outcomes are audited.

name: approvals_list
description: List what waits for an owner. approvals: promotes held above the app's policy band (hold id, release, band, proposer, age). challenges: owner commands waiting for the owner to approve in the admin (id, command, plan, expiry, approval_url). Agents cannot approve either. Needs an owner token.

name: arrange_apps
description: Lay out an installed app on the home screen: pinned (first), hidden (not on the home screen, still opens with switch_app), position (0 first) and schedule (days, from, to: the app shows only then, e.g. a weekly planner Monday to Friday 08:00-18:00 and weekend plans on Saturday). Leave days out or pass an empty list for every day. Pass schedule: null to always show. Fails with not_installed or bad_placement. The home screen text says which apps are showing and why one is not. Logged in device_log.

name: attach_session
description: Attach to the phone of a live `shipvo run` in this project (read from .shipvo/run.json) and return its screen. The person sees every action in their browser. Same as open_app with attach: 'always', without needing the app id.

app.description: App id; default: the app of the live run

name: audit_log
description: Read the app's release audit log, newest first: who (actor) did what (action) to which release (subject) and when (at). Read-only. Needs an owner token.

limit.description: Rows to return (default 50, max 200; values outside are clamped)

action.description: Only rows with this action, for example rollback

name: back
description: Go back one screen. The result starts with 'Change: none | content changed | new screen | scrolled'.

compact.description: When the change is 'content changed', return only the added/removed lines, not the whole screen

wait_for.description: Use after any action that starts work. Wait until this appears (a ref, a text, or role+name), or disappears with gone: true. The result says Waited: matched or timed out.

timeout_ms.description: How long wait_for and settle may take, in ms (default 2000)

settle.description: Wait until the screen stops changing (two equal reads 100 ms apart), up to timeout_ms. Use after any action that starts work. A slow result can still follow a pause, so prefer wait_for when you know the expected text.

name: browser_back
description: Go back one page in the phone browser. Returns the snapshot.

name: browser_click
description: Click an element of the phone browser's page by ref from browser_snapshot. Returns the new snapshot.

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. e12 or f1e12

name: browser_close_tab
description: Close a tab of the phone browser by its index from browser_tabs. Returns the remaining tabs.

name: browser_open
description: Open a web page in the phone's Chromium (separate from the app) and return its snapshot. Private hosts (localhost, 127.x, 10.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.x, CGNAT, .local, .internal) are refused with host_not_allowed unless you opt in.

name: browser_screenshot
description: A PNG of the phone browser's page.

name: browser_scroll
description: Scroll the phone browser's page by dy CSS pixels (positive is down) and dx (positive is right). Returns the snapshot.

name: browser_snapshot
description: The phone browser's page as an accessibility tree with refs, marked source "web" (untrusted).

name: browser_tabs
description: List the phone browser's tabs (index, url, title, which is active). Titles are untrusted web content.

name: browser_type
description: Type into a field of the phone browser's page by ref (replaces its content). Returns the new snapshot.

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. e12 or f1e12

name: browser_wait_for
description: Wait until text appears in the phone browser's page, or is gone (gone: true). Fails with code timeout. Returns the snapshot.

name: check_for_update
description: Ask the update source for a newer release: checks its signature and hash and downloads it. Ends in ready, or idle with reason verify_failed or download_failed (the release is never applied). Fails with no_update when nothing newer exists or no source is set. Simulated; each state change is logged in device_log.

name: close_panels
description: Close the notification shade, Notification Center or Control Center (swipe up).

name: create_app
description: Describe an app and it appears on the phone. Pass an app spec (JSON, shipvo.app/v0: data, actions, screens). The spec is checked first: every problem comes back with its path and a fix, and nothing is installed until it is valid. A valid spec is started, gets an icon on the home screen, and opens (pass open: false to stay where you are). Every control is labelled, so tap, type, scroll and screen work on it like any app, and each action can be run by name with run_app_action. Fails with invalid_spec, bad_app_id or already_installed. Logged in device_log as a real create.

id.description: App id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 40

name.description: Name under the icon. Default: app.name in the spec

style.description: Look of the app. Default android

open.description: Open the app right away (default true)

name: device_log
description: What the app did with the device in this session: permission prompts and answers, location reads, scans, fingerprint checks, payments, notifications, shares.

name: device_reset
description: Put the simulated phone back to a known state (permissions undetermined, default location, nothing in front of the camera, log cleared), optionally with a new profile.

name: dismiss_notification
description: Swipe a notification away in the open shade (newest if no id), or Clear all with all: true.

name: end_session
description: Close the session and get a report: steps taken, and the orders the app sent to its backend during the session.

name: export_phone_apps
description: Copy the spec apps (made with create_app) out of the phone. Returns JSON with, per app, id, name, style (android or ios), spec, data (what was entered into its collections), settings and its home-screen layout (placement: pinned, hidden, position, schedule) when it has one. Pass ids to export only some. Vault secrets and keys are never included. Give the result to import_phone_apps on another phone to recreate the apps. Fails with not_installed (an id is not a spec app).

ids.description: App ids to export. Default: every spec app

name: export_test
description: Turn the steps taken in this session (tap, type, scroll, back, set_device) into a @shipvo/test script and return its source. Read-only. Targets are named by their visible text; ambiguous ones become TODO comments and password fields use an environment variable instead of the typed value.

name: find_apps
description: Search the Store by need, for example "split bills". Matches the query against app name, description and tags (case-insensitive, word based) and filters by country, language and currency when an app declares them; apps that declare nothing for a filter still match. Returns up to limit apps (default 10, max 25) with id, name, one-line description, version and whether it is installed, best match first. An empty list means nothing matched. Fails with store_unreachable when the marketplace cannot be reached (nothing is guessed). Install a result on the simulator with install_app, or on the person's own phone with request_app_install. Logged in device_log as simulated.

query.description: What the person needs, for example "split bills"

name: get_network_profile
description: Read the phone's current network profile name (online until set_network_profile or phone.json changes it).

name: get_settings
description: Read the phone's system settings from the Settings screen: dark_mode, font_size (small, default, large, largest), bold_text, reduce_motion, language (en, fr, ar) and rtl. Returns each setting and the screen as rows.

name: get_update_state
description: The phone's OTA update state: idle, checking, downloading, ready, applied or reverted, the running release, the held release, and the last reason (verify_failed, download_failed or crash_loop). Simulated and logged in device_log.

name: hide_app
description: Hide an installed app from the home screen and the app list, or show it again with hidden: false. The app keeps its data and still opens with switch_app and run_app_action. Works for Store apps and apps made with create_app, and survives update_app. Fails with not_installed. Logged in device_log.

hidden.description: true to hide, false to show

name: import_phone_apps
description: Put apps from export_phone_apps on this phone, with their data, settings and home-screen layout. Every spec is checked first: all problems come back with their path (for example apps[1].spec.screens) and nothing is installed unless all are valid. An id that is already installed fails with already_installed unless replace is true. Android and iOS styles are kept. Fails with invalid_spec or already_installed.

replace.description: Overwrite apps with the same id (default false)

name: install_app
description: Install a Store app on the phone, as tapping Install in the Store screen does. The app icon appears on the home screen. Fails with unknown_app (not in the Store) or already_installed. If the marketplace is unreachable the phone's own Store list is used. Logged in device_log as simulated: nothing real is installed.

name: job_status
description: Read a slow job started by publish_preview or upload_build. Returns { status: running | done | failed, job } with the result when done or a typed error { code, error } when failed. Pass wait_ms to wait for it (long poll, default 0, max 55000). A job id from another key is not found. Jobs are kept for 15 minutes after they finish.

job.description: Job id from a tool that returned status running

wait_ms.description: How long to wait while it is still running (default 0)

name: kill_app
description: Swipe the app's card away in the app switcher (call open_recents first). The app is killed: the next resume_app is a cold start, with storage kept. Fails with recents_not_open otherwise.

name: list_apps
description: Apps this server can open, with what each one does. Optional query filters by name, description or category (e.g. 'shop', 'douala').

name: list_installed_apps
description: List the apps installed on the person's persistent phone, the same in every chat and assistant. Needs PN_ASSISTANT_TOKEN.

name: list_sessions
description: Open simulator sessions (phones) on this server: id, app, platform, room, who opened it (the MCP client name), start time and current screen title. Use to resume after a reconnect or to see who shares a room.

name: list_store_apps
description: List the apps in the phone's Store: the marketplace apps from the control plane, each with id, name, bundle url and version. Fails with store_unreachable when the marketplace cannot be reached (nothing is guessed). Install one with install_app.

name: lock
description: Press the power button: the simulated phone locks and shows the lock screen. The app and its screen are kept. While locked, tap, type, scroll and back fail with phone_locked. Logged in device_log as simulated.

name: notifications
description: The notification shade: notifications delivered to the simulated phone in this session (their banners vanish after 5 s, like a heads-up on a real phone).

name: open_app
description: Opens the phone in the user's browser so they can watch. Opens an app in a phone-sized session and returns its first screen. With no live `shipvo run` for the project, it starts one (pick platform: 'android' or 'ios') when the project has `shipvo` installed, or when show is true, and only from a local (stdio) server. A live run on the other platform is attached as it is and the result says so. screen, tap, type, scroll, back and screenshot work on that phone. The result says whether the phone is visible and its URL.

app.description: App id from list_apps, optionally with a release: 'tide' (local build), 'tide@latest' or 'tide@r13' (the published release phones run), or 'tide@build:<id>' (a build from upload_build, on the hosted phone)

session.description: Session name (default: generated). One session is one phone.

room.description: Room name. Every session opened with the same room on the same simulator shares one backend (orders, content, telemetry), read and written through the same store. Without room, each session has its own. 1 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -.

seed_cart.description: Start with these items already in the cart (test shortcut). Each line: { product_id, quantity }; { id, qty } also works.

platform.description: Which phone to show: 'android' or 'ios' (default: the live run's, else android). Ignored when no phone is started (show false, attach never, or a live run is attached as it is)

show.description: true: open the phone in the user's browser so they can watch (default on a computer with a desktop, when the project has `shipvo` installed; a server over HTTP never starts a run). false: headless, nobody sees it (default in CI).

attach.description: 'auto' (default): drive the phone of a live `shipvo run` in this project if there is one, else a headless session. 'never': always headless. 'always': error if there is no live `shipvo run`.

name: open_control_center
description: iPhone only: swipe down from the top right to open Control Center (airplane, Wi-Fi, mobile data, focus, orientation lock, brightness, dark mode). Android fails with no_control_center: use open_notifications.

name: open_notification
description: Tap a notification from the shade (newest if no id is given): the app handles it exactly as if its banner was tapped.

name: open_notifications
description: Pull down from the top. Android: the first call opens the notification shade (a few quick-settings tiles and the notifications); a second call expands all tiles. iPhone: opens Notification Center (grouped by app). Returns the tiles and notifications.

expand.description: Android: go straight to all tiles

name: open_recents
description: Open the app switcher: the app goes to the background and its card is shown. resume_app opens the card again; kill_app swipes it away.

name: open_url
description: Open a deep link (such as myapp://item/3) in the running app, as a push tap, auth callback or share link would. Fails with invalid_url if the text has no scheme, or no_handler if apps declare URL schemes and none matches; a match returns the owning app id. Otherwise fails with no_url_listener if the app does not listen for URLs.

url.description: The URL to deliver, e.g. myapp://item/3

name: owner_command
description: Run an owner command against the live app (changes are audited). Commands that cannot be undone or reach users (publish, prices, offers, deletes, API keys) do nothing and return { code: "needs_confirm", plan } first: show the plan to the owner, then ask the owner to approve the returned challenge in the admin (approval_url). You cannot approve it yourself, and confirm: true alone does nothing. Once approved, call again with the same args and approval: <challenge id>. An approval works once, for 10 minutes, for exactly those args.

approval.description: Challenge id the owner approved; pass the same args

name: owner_describe
description: List the owner commands of an app (content, prices, offers, orders, publish). Needs PN_OWNER_TOKEN.

name: pin_app
description: Pin an installed app to the top of the home screen (Android and iOS style), after any apps pinned before it, or unpin it with pinned: false. Works for Store apps and apps made with create_app, and survives update_app. Fails with not_installed. Logged in device_log.

pinned.description: true to pin, false to unpin

name: press_home
description: Press Home: the app goes to the background (it receives AppState "background") and the phone shows the home screen with the app icon. While there, tap, type, scroll and back fail with app_not_foreground. Call resume_app to bring the app back (AppState "active"). Logged as simulated.

name: publish_preview
description: Build the app in PN_APP_DIR (or the current folder) with the simulated device and publish a shareable web preview to here.now, no account. The link is PUBLIC and expires in 24 hours; claimUrl keeps it. Returns { url, claimUrl, expiresAt }. Needs @shipvo/cli (npx). Slow: waits up to wait_ms (default 20000), then returns { status: "running", job }; call job_status with that job. Calling again while it runs returns the same job.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for the result before returning { status: "running", job } (default 20000). Read it later with job_status.

name: push_notification
description: Deliver a push notification to the simulated phone; it appears as a banner the agent can tap. The app receives it only if notification permission is granted; otherwise nothing is delivered.

name: record_marker
description: Add a chapter at the current time of the running recording.

name: record_start
description: Start recording the phone frame to an MP4 under .shipvo/recordings/. Use record_marker for chapters and record_stop to finish.

show_taps.description: Draw a finger dot and ripple on taps and a trail on scrolls (default true)

background.description: Behind the phone: "brand", "plain" (white) or a CSS colour such as "#102030"

lumi.description: Include Lumi and its step captions in the video (default true for recordings; set false for a plain phone).

lumi_voice.description: Lumi speaks its short step lines with the energetic voice preset (default false). Needs python3, ffmpeg and network access for the voice. Ignored when record_stop gets a narration file.

name: record_stop
description: Stop the recording and write the MP4. Returns the file, duration in seconds, size and chapters. With music: true, mixes a ducked music bed under the video and writes a credits JSON next to it (credit the track where you publish).

music.description: Mix a music bed under the video (default false). Needs python3, ffmpeg and ffprobe; picks a track from Jamendo unless SHIPVO_MUSIC_FILE is set.

narration.description: Path to a wav with a voice track. It is mixed over the video, trimmed to the video length (the result says so), and ducks the music when music is true.

name: refresh_app
description: Fetch the data of a spec app now (its http data sources) and redraw the open screen if anything changed. Apps with a refresh interval in the spec also refresh by themselves. The result lists the sources that changed and any errors; a source that fails keeps its last good data. Fails with not_installed. Logged in device_log as data_refresh.

name: request_app_install
description: Ask to add an app to the person's own persistent phone (not the simulator). Returns a consent card: app name, publisher, the permissions it asks for, and approve_url and decline_url. Show the card to the person and tell them to open a link themselves: you cannot approve, and nothing is installed until they do. A card expires after 15 minutes. Fails with unknown_app, already_installed or unauthorized. Needs PN_ASSISTANT_TOKEN.

name: request_secret
description: Ask the person for an API key without it passing through this chat. Returns a one-time link to the Shipvo vault page (valid 10 minutes, works once) and a notice to show the person. The key goes straight into the vault: you never see it. Tell the person to open the link, then call secret_status to learn whether it was saved. Needs an owner token.

name.description: Name for the key, e.g. STRIPE_KEY (letters, digits and underscores)

purpose.description: Why the app needs it, in plain English; shown to the person on the vault page

access.description: Access the key should have (default read)

name: restart
description: Restart the simulated phone from the power menu: a boot screen, then the app starts fresh (cold start). Storage is kept. Returns the first screen. Logged in device_log as simulated.

name: resume_app
description: Tap the app icon on the home screen, or its card in the app switcher: the app comes back (AppState "active") with its screen kept. Fails with app_in_foreground if it is already in front.

name: run_app_action
description: Run one action of an app made with create_app, by name, with its input (for example add_task with { title }). The action changes the app's data the same way tapping its form does, and the open screen shows the result. Fails with not_installed (no such spec app) or action_failed (the action refused the input, with the reason).

name: screen
description: The current screen as an accessibility tree with refs.

name: screenshot
description: A PNG of the phone screen (for checking layout, colours, images). The result says `source`: tab-capture (the person's live tab), rendered (the page drawn to an image; it lists what it could not draw) or headless. The tree from `screen` is usually enough to act.

name: scroll
description: Scroll the page (down/up) or a horizontal rail (right/left, give the rail's ref). Returns the new screen. The result starts with 'Change: none | content changed | new screen | scrolled'.

ref.description: Scroll inside this element (a rail or list); omit for the page

compact.description: When the change is 'content changed', return only the added/removed lines, not the whole screen

wait_for.description: Use after any action that starts work. Wait until this appears (a ref, a text, or role+name), or disappears with gone: true. The result says Waited: matched or timed out.

timeout_ms.description: How long wait_for and settle may take, in ms (default 2000)

settle.description: Wait until the screen stops changing (two equal reads 100 ms apart), up to timeout_ms. Use after any action that starts work. A slow result can still follow a pause, so prefer wait_for when you know the expected text.

name: secret_status
description: Whether a key is saved in the vault, as { saved, valid, access }. Never returns the key. valid is null when it was not checked. Needs an owner token.

name: set_device
description: Change what the simulated phone has: location, the address book (contacts), calendar events, files for the file picker, a barcode in front of the camera, permission states, whether the fingerprint will match, whether a payment will be approved, network on/off. Takes effect for the next action.

contacts.description: Replace the address book the app can read (needs contacts permission)

calendar.description: Replace the calendar events the app can read (needs calendar permission)

files.description: Replace the files the file picker offers

dnd.description: Do Not Disturb: notifications go to the shade without a banner

source.description: "simulated" forces the simulated camera, microphone and location even when a person could grant the real ones, for reproducible runs

name: set_network_profile
description: Make the phone's network behave like a named profile: online, offline, 2g, 3g, slow-4g, spotty or low-end-4g. The app's fetch and XHR calls wait and fail as the profile says (offline rejects every call). The numbers are simulation settings, not measurements of a real network. Mock rules from set_network_mocks still win. Fails with unknown_profile for a name that does not exist. Logged in device_log as simulated.

profile.description: online, offline, 2g, 3g, slow-4g, spotty or low-end-4g

name: set_phone_time
description: Set the phone's clock to a time like 2026-11-14T09:00:00 so scheduled apps show or hide as they would then, or pass null to go back to the real time. The clock stays at the time you set; it does not tick. Fails with bad_time.

at.description: ISO time without a zone, or null for the real time

name: set_setting
description: Change one system setting, as a person would in the phone's Settings screen. The app sees it through Appearance (dark_mode), PixelRatio.getFontScale (font_size), AccessibilityInfo (bold_text, reduce_motion), I18nManager (rtl) and Intl (language). Setting language to ar turns rtl on; en and fr turn it off. Fails with unknown_setting for a key that does not exist and bad_value for a value it does not take. Logged in device_log as simulated.

key.description: dark_mode, font_size, bold_text, reduce_motion, language or rtl

value.description: true or false for switches; small, default, large or largest for font_size; en, fr or ar for language

name: switch_app
description: Open an installed app (tap its icon on the home screen): it becomes current_app and comes to the front. Fails with not_installed. Logged in device_log as simulated.

name: tap
description: Tap a button, link or choice by ref. Returns the new screen. The result starts with 'Change: none | content changed | new screen | scrolled'. Work that starts on a tap (paying, saving, loading) can finish after this returns, so the screen may show 'Paying...' or a spinner. Do not report that as the result: pass wait_for with the text you expect (and gone: true for the spinner), or settle: true, before you read the outcome or do anything else.

ref.description: Element ref from the screen, e.g. e42

compact.description: When the change is 'content changed', return only the added/removed lines, not the whole screen

wait_for.description: Use after any action that starts work. Wait until this appears (a ref, a text, or role+name), or disappears with gone: true. The result says Waited: matched or timed out.

timeout_ms.description: How long wait_for and settle may take, in ms (default 2000)

settle.description: Wait until the screen stops changing (two equal reads 100 ms apart), up to timeout_ms. Use after any action that starts work. A slow result can still follow a pause, so prefer wait_for when you know the expected text.

name: toggle_tile
description: Flip a quick-settings tile in the open shade or Control Center. It changes the simulated device like set_device: Wi-Fi and mobile data both off take the network offline, dark_mode changes the app's colour scheme, dnd stops banners. Tiles: wifi, mobile_data, airplane, location, dark_mode, dnd, auto_rotate, flashlight (Android); airplane, wifi, mobile_data, focus, orientation_lock, brightness, dark_mode (iPhone). Fails with tile_not_visible if the panel is closed.

value.description: true or false; 0 to 100 for brightness. Omit to flip.

name: type
description: Type into a text field by ref (replaces its content). Returns the new screen. The result starts with 'Change: none | content changed | new screen | scrolled'. Also gives the field's value after typing.

ref.description: Element ref from the screen, e.g. e42

compact.description: When the change is 'content changed', return only the added/removed lines, not the whole screen

wait_for.description: Use after any action that starts work. Wait until this appears (a ref, a text, or role+name), or disappears with gone: true. The result says Waited: matched or timed out.

timeout_ms.description: How long wait_for and settle may take, in ms (default 2000)

settle.description: Wait until the screen stops changing (two equal reads 100 ms apart), up to timeout_ms. Use after any action that starts work. A slow result can still follow a pause, so prefer wait_for when you know the expected text.

name: uninstall_app
description: Remove an installed app from the phone. If it was open, the phone returns to the home screen. Fails with not_installed. Logged in device_log as simulated.

name: unlock
description: Swipe up on the lock screen. Returns to the same screen as before the lock. Fails with not_locked if the phone is not locked. Logged in device_log as simulated.

name: update_app
description: Change an app made with create_app by giving its new spec. The change is a new version of the same app: the data and settings the person entered stay, and the open screen shows the new look right away. A spec with problems comes back with each problem's path and a fix, and the running version is not touched. Fails with not_installed (no such spec app) or invalid_spec. Logged in device_log with the old and new version.

name: upload_build
description: Build the app in this project with the simulated device (the same build `shipvo sim` makes), upload it to the hosted phone for this key, and return a build id. Then call open_app("<app>@build:<id>") on the hosted server. The build is private to your account and is deleted when it expires. Runs only on the local (stdio) server, because it reads your project.

dir.description: Project folder (default: the server's working directory)

app.description: App id (default: read from the project's shipvo config)

skip_build.description: Upload the existing sim-dist folder without building again

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for the result before returning { status: "running", job } (default 20000). Read it later with job_status.
